jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.desc: Why loveholidays? At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away. We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams , you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams. The impact you’ll have: As our Senior CRM Executive, you will play a key role in delivering and improving CRM campaigns and customer journeys across our channels. You’ll be close to the detail of campaign build, journey optimisation and performance, with the opportunity to grow your ownership over time. You’ll work closely with the CRM Manager, Head of CRM and wider Marketing, Product and Engineering teams to turn agreed customer opportunities and briefs into well-executed campaigns and journeys. You’ll help move us away from legacy campaign cycles by building reliable, increasingly automated lifecycle activity. We are looking for a thoughtful, high-velocity operator who can turn clear direction into accurate live journeys. Your day-to-day: You’ll build and maintain multi-channel automated journeys using branching logic, API triggers, and real-time data, working from agreed briefs and priorities. Identify manual bottlenecks and support the implementation of AI-assisted workflows, using tools like n8n and Claude (training will be provided). Use Braze to identify optimisation opportunities within your journeys and help make delivery faster, more accurate, and more consistent. Provide hands-on campaign support to the wider team in deploying campaigns. You’ll ensure accurate execution through rigorous, increasingly automated QA processes. Work collaboratively with Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver agreed workstreams and help create a frictionless experience from search to rebooking. Monitor the performance of your campaigns and journeys. You’ll be comfortable using Looker to maintain reports, monitor health metrics, and surface actionable insights that support optimisation. Your skillset: You are a reliable operator who takes ownership of your assigned campaigns and journeys from brief through deployment. You ask the right questions, flag risks early, and deliver with consistency and precision. You can move from a clear brief to deployment rapidly, maintaining high standards and following agreed processes. You are naturally curious and look for practical ways to improve processes, reduce manual tasks, and make delivery more efficient. You have experience with Looker, Tableau, or SQL, and BQ and confidence using data to monitor performance. Hands-on experience with Braze or similar. You should be comfortable with Liquid logic, audience segmentation and personalisation. You are comfortable working with data models and propensity scores to support relevant segmentation and measure campaign impact. The ability to work well across Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams, taking direction and communicating clearly to keep delivery on track. Desirable: Experience supporting CRM activity across multiple international markets, including handling localisation, consent frameworks, and currency differences within automated journeys Familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools Experience writing Liquid logic for content personalisation Exposure to AI-assisted workflows or agentic tooling Background in travel, marketplace, or another high-frequency transactional category The interview journey: Meeting with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager Final Stage interview in office presenting pre-determined task and a meeting a few stakeholders - 1 hour 30 mins Perks of joining us: Company pension contributions at 5%. Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up. Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends. 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum. Ability to buy and sell annual leave. Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers. At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey. jobs.title: Working Student (f/m/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI Taskforce)
jobs.desc: Your mission Everyone's talking about AI. We decide how it actually gets used across the company. A $400 billion market. A profitable scale-up rethinking it with AI and a global freelance network. And in the middle of it, a team that doesn't primarily write code - it decides what AI should actually deliver: for more than 25,000 Talents in over 70 countries, through automation and smarter processes. We're looking for you as a Working Student (f/m/d) Strategy Business Development for our cross-functional strategic taskforce, based at our headquarters in Munich-Schwabing. You'll work at the intersection of strategy, business and AI - as a sparring partner for AI engineers, product and operations experts, and a former BCG consultant. Not as another engineer on the team, but as the person who makes sure the team builds the right thing. This isn't a typical working student role for techies. You'll structure problems, build business cases, evaluate AI applications from a business perspective, and translate between what's technically possible and what's strategically right. The concepts you work on don't end up in a drawer - they get prototyped, discussed, and feed directly into our leadership team's decisions. What You'll Actually Do AI strategy, not AI code: You'll work on strategic AI initiatives like our Talent Assistant or AutoQA 2.0 (AI-based voice file analysis) - not as a developer, but as someone who structures requirements, sets priorities, and turns early ideas into solid feature concepts. Our AI engineers handle the technical build; you make sure they're building the right thing. Ideas become decisions: You'll analyze complex questions, build business cases using classic case logic, and develop decision-making material for our leadership team. Your analysis directly influences which AI initiatives get greenlit. AI needs structure: Large language models are only as good as the data behind them. You'll define competency frameworks and evaluation logic that make our AI systems smarter - the content logic, not the technical implementation. Your own projects, real ownership: You'll independently own topics from first analysis to first concept - a new AI use case, a workflow that's still manual today, an automation, a new approach. The content changes; the standard doesn't. You get responsibility, not just tasks. Working where the leverage is highest: You'll support the team wherever the most interesting strategic questions are emerging right now. That means variety, high speed, and visible impact. Why This Role Will Accelerate Your Growth Here, you won't learn to code - you'll learn how to evaluate AI investments, build business cases that hold up in front of leadership, and structure complex topics so they turn into measurable business impact. It's the exact craft you'll later need in strategy consulting or corporate strategy - except here, the recommendation actually gets implemented instead of ending up in a slide deck. You'll work closely with a former BCG consultant, AI engineers, and product experts, moving daily between strategy, business judgment, and AI. Our last working student in this role went on to join us as a trainee - not because we promise it, but because she'd already taken on real responsibility during her time with us. Your skillset Academic background: You're currently pursuing a Master's degree (business administration, economics, industrial engineering, or comparable) and already bring some practical experience - ideally with a strategic or analytical focus. AI-savvy, not an AI engineer: You don't need to code or build models. But you use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as a power user for research, analysis, and structuring - and you understand how AI changes business processes. More important than deep technical knowledge: you can identify what problem an AI use case is actually meant to solve. Skills: You structure complex issues cleanly and are confident enough in PowerPoint and Excel to put together compelling management presentations and business cases. Mindset: You don't wait for someone to explain the next step. You dig into new topics on your own, think entrepreneurially, and want to develop solutions rather than just work through tasks. Language skills: You communicate and present fluently in German and English, and naturally bring a healthy sense of humor. Availability: You have 16–20 hours per week during the semester to work on-site at our Munich headquarters, with flexible scaling up to full-time during semester breaks. Your winning deal Your opportunity: From day one, you'll contribute to one of the company's most strategic AI initiatives and help build solutions that improve the daily work of thousands of people. Your mentor: Work closely with a former BCG consultant who will coach, challenge, and support your development. Your network: Collaborate every day with AI Engineers, Product, Strategy, and Operations experts - exposure that's rarely found in traditional working student roles. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack - Web Engineering
jobs.desc: div class= content-intro p Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. /p /div h3 strong What is The Role /strong /h3 p elastic.co is how Elastic talks to the world — it s where potential customers first encounter our products and where existing ones come to learn more. As a Software Engineer II on the Web Engineering team you ll own meaningful parts of that experience: building the features, systems, and infrastructure that keep the site fast, reliable, and effective at scale. The ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable writing React components, designing backend services, shipping to production, and owning what they build once it s live — including on-call response and security triage. /p p You ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to ship features that improve the site s quality and performance in a distributed, async-first environment. /p h3 strong What You Will Be Doing /strong /h3 ul li Own features across the full stack from component design and backend services to deployment pipelines and ship production code end-to-end. /li li Instrument client-side performance (Core Web Vitals, error tracking, real-user monitoring) alongside backend logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards. /li li Partner with product managers, designers, and other developers to build, test, and release features for elastic.co. /li li Write clean, maintainable code and take ownership for its behavior in production. /li li Triage, investigate, and resolve security vulnerability reports — from reproduction and root-cause analysis to fix, validation, and coordinated disclosure. /li li Participate in code reviews for your team. /li li Diagnose and resolve production issues spanning client regressions to backend failures, and participate in an on-call rotation for an always-on service. /li /ul h3 What You Bring /h3 ul li 3+ years in a full-stack or frontend role, with proven TypeScript and React depth (component architecture, performance, state management) and hands-on backend experience shipping and operating production services. /li li Production experience with Node.js, Python, or Go — enough to build, deploy, debug, and maintain backend services independently. /li li Experience owning CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) end-to-end, including front-end build tooling, bundle optimization, and deployment automation without a dedicated ops team. /li li A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. /li li Experienced in building for high availability and scalability at real production scale, including writing secure code, identifying vulnerabilities, and resolving security issues under pressure. /li li Ability to work autonomously in a globally distributed team. /li /ul div class= content-conclusion h2 strong Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People /strong /h2 p As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. /p p We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. /p ul li Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary /li li Health coverage for you and your family in many locations /li li Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles /li li Generous number of vacation days each year /li li Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service /li li Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love /li li Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave /li /ul p Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. /p p We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals.
